recipe.causal_mask: Original upstream mask; future/stale positions excluded

benchmark.metric: Generated audio frames / synchronized wall seconds

recipe.fallback: Original decoder on unsupported graph/compiler errors; whole-request seed replay on later compilation failure
recipe.oom: Preserves existing worker error/retry handling; CUDA OOM is not hidden

checks.real_cpu_graphs: Both LoRA target sets on actual 10-codebook DualAR models; exactly one full graph across positions 1,4,12 using CPU graph.forward backend
checks.cache_mask: Full-cache and active-prefix logits match even with random stale future cache values
checks.sampling: Tiny-model original/compiled CPU tokens match under the same seed
checks.request_replay: Partial compiled audio discarded; seed restored; original decoder selected; non-compiler errors not retried
checks.warm_selection: Slow/warmup results excluded; original retained for less than 5% gain; compiler failure fallback verified
checks.server_restart: Exact PID/script verification, active/queued request refusal and unrelated-process refusal tested with mocked process signals
checks.reporting: Worker option propagation, optimization report and result timing persistence verified
checks.launcher_check: passed; exact listening-selected checkpoint/reference hashes unchanged

limitations: Sandbox has no CUDA/driver access or socket creation; actual Inductor CUDA Graph execution and speed require host launch.
CPU graph backend checks tracing/correctness, not generated CUDA kernels or CUDA Graph capture.
The 32-token startup benchmark does not establish speed or listening quality for every request.
Compiled CUDA floating point/RNG may produce different audio at the same seed.
